system.description: You throw a handful of salt, copper wire, or dried herbs at a foe within 30' and shove a spark of will into it.

outcomes.triumph: 2d8 damage, and you choose whether a Photonic Surge triggers on the target.
outcomes.failure: Half damage, and a Photonic Surge triggers.
outcomes.ruin: No damage, and a Photonic Surge triggers centred on you.
